notes.title: Update 0.11.10 is now Live.
notes.content:
[h1]Hi and welcome to patch 0.11.10[/h1]

So what is new in this update?

[b]ERA 10 Tasks[/b]
Era 10 tasks are now available and this will also unlock the final task achievement. (leaving just 2 achievements that cannot be obtained at the moment).

[b]The final armour and weapons Science Lab unlock![/b]
For those who wish to push the limits before they try the last missions of the game, there is no the ultimate weaponry. The Minigun and Power Armour.
Power Armour comes in 2 parts, the main armour and a separate helm.
All the new items come with fine version upgrades.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/de5015ed39a83b7606d71f353630eee1b577c715.jpg[/img]

[b]Added Tooltips to the Central Plot buildings[/b]
You will now be able to see the damage values of your militia, including their skill bonus.
Also the protection values of walls, guard houses, pits as well as the healing and health from welfare buildings.

[b]Resource Output Tooltips[/b]
Added Community Request to put resource output on the building tooltips in Settlements. Any buildings that create a resource will now display these and any rare resources.

[h1]Full patch notes[/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added: Power Armour & Fine version
[*]Added: Power Armour Helm & Fine version
[*]Added: Minigun & Fine version
[*]Added: Building Tech Tree for Era 9
[*]Added: Building Tech Tree for Era 10
[*]Added: Tooltips to the central plot buildings
[*]Added: Tooltips for resource output.
[*]Added: Community Request for scrolling through characters while in the character sheet view.
[*]Unlocked: Science Lab - Ballistics 8
[*]Unlocked: Science Lab - Composites 6
[/list]

[b]Changed[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed: Put the text update for snowing conditions in settlement 6, back into the text screen.
[*]Removed: the words "Work In progress" from the Character List tooltip.
[*]Changed: the tooltips on the Data Core objects, I have plans for these.
[*]Changed; the way settlement attacks are calculated 
[*]Changed: the calculations for Scouting for Merchants
[*]Changed: Scientists in the Science Lab can now also read books while they work!
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where a character in a guard post would not display.
[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes it was not possible to place a character in a guard post.
[*]Fixed an issue where changing the follow on recipe qty would change the current recipe qty.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Blight tasks would not update without restarting the client.
[*]Fixed the scrolling issue in the Character List.
[*]Fixed an error with 0 attackers against a settlement
[*]Fixed an error where power usage was not always recalculated when changing machines
[*]Fixed as error with some pit defence damage
[*]Fixed an error with the healing rate bonus on some buildings
[*]Fixed an error where watch towers were kicking out characters on loading
[*]Fixed an error where a scout would not always return to a watch tower and instead drop to the overflow bar
[*]Fixed an art error where the wounded status would stay in the scouting window
[*]Fixed a typo in the Whiteout encounter
[*]Fixed a typo in 'Bring it back' adventure
[*]Fixed an error with the basic Power Armour picture.
[*]Fixed an error in the way 'no preference' was being handles while scouting
[/list]

[b]Twitter[/b]
Please follow Settlements on Twitter:  @Treongames

[b]Reviews[/b]
Please find the time to post a review on steam - Thank you!

notes.content:

Unlike other weeks, there will be no rush to get this patch tested and into live by the weekend.
Instead this update will take as long as it takes. That being said, if the amount of bug fixes in the beta grows large enough, it will automatically drop into live to make sure all players benefit from a bug free environment.

So what is new in this update?

[b]ERA 10 Tasks[/b]
Era 10 tasks are now available and this will also unlock the final task achievement. (leaving just 2 achievements that cannot be obtained at the moment).

[b]The final Armour and Weapons Science Lab unlock![/b]
For those who wish to push the limits before they try the last missions of the game, there is now the ultimate weaponry. The Minigun and Power Armour.
Power Armour comes in 2 parts, the main armour and a separate helm.
All the new items come with fine version upgrades.

notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to this weeks game update![/h1]
This week we have a brand new adventure quest and the 2nd victory condition is almost complete.

A full patch list is below!
Thank you as always to those in the beta branch helping with testing.


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added: The adventure quest - The Hunt for Varalis
[*]Added: Item - Lethal Bio-Grenade
[*]Added: 2 new monsters unique to the new adventures.
[*]Added: Special Boss monster for the new adventures.
[*]Unlocked: The Blight 9

[b]Changed[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed: The drawing method for factory prints
[*]Changed: You can no longer launch a settlement assault if there are no enemies massing to attack.
[*]Changed: Bronze ingots now take 1 Copper and 2 Tin, instead of the other way around.

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: An issue with the character list slider not moving correctly.
[*]Fixed: The standard difficulty mode button would sometimes become hidden.
[*]Fixed: The production list would still allow you to craft while a building was upgrading - causing an error.
[*]Fixed: 2 potential missing character bugs have been located and fixed.
[*]Fixed: Hotfix for a bug that would cause people in the guard huts to to return from scouting.
[*]Fixed: An error when mousing over the progress book on full screen.
[*]Fixed: Some rare critical hit error feedback.
[*]Fixed: The ability to still get extra people even though the settlement population is at maximum.
[*]Fixed: Several production error from factories and a cleaner switching of recipes. Any new recipe in a factory will now default to INF production, even if the previous was on an unfinished QTY run.
[*]Fixed: Clone issue with the Home function.
[*]Fixed: An issue where if a character dies, the helmet, misc slot 2 and pet would carry over to the new character.
[/list]

Please remember to post a review of the game!
Thank you, enjoy the game!
Tormunda

notes.title: UPDATE 0.11.8 Goes Live
notes.content:
Hello all and welcome to the next of my regular game updates.

This update is focuses on the way I am generating art and cleaning up some of the code to increase performance in key areas.

Although the game itself is not a CPU drain or complex art, these changes need to happen if I am going to supply better artwork in the future and add more content as the game matures.

[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added: The character face update has been rolled out once more, this time with some extra changes to the character picture. 
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed: Health is now a curved increase in hit point gain. Making it valuable to push for an extra point if possible. Also negative health will have an increased impact as it gets higher.
[*]Changed: The way wounds are displayed. 
[*]Changed: Various artwork changes.
[*]Changed: Fine Scale armour is now listed as Heavy armour, instead of light.
[*]Changed: Razor's Fang Necklace now also gives +1 Health
[*]Changed: Different game difficulties now effect when wounds take place.
[*]Changed: Various game art changes.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: An issue with the White Wolf combat encounter healing incorrectly.
[*]Fixed: The lingering wound syndrome
[*]Fixed: Stopped the ability to use off-hand weapons while using a 2handed weapon.
[*]Fixed: Added a script to try an catch the missing scout issue - please report if you still get a lost scout.
[*]Fixed: Fleeing from combat would sometimes unpause the game even though it says it is paused.
[*]Fixed: An error in the health tooltip calculation when certain buildings were available.
[*]Fixed: Several minor text issues.
[*]Fixed: Misc art errors.
[*]Fixed: The multi-run selection is now visible when the upgrade button is also showing.
[*]Fixed: A cloning issue with last update
[/list]

[b]WRITING A REVIEW![/b]
Writing a review is often something players do in seconds when there is something wrong but seldom do players write reviews when they are enjoying playing.
Reviews are vital to an indie game health - so a big hug from me if you take the time to post one!
Thank you
Tormunda

notes.title: Live Update 0.11.7
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Settlements Update 0.11.7[/h1]

[u]VICTORY![/u]
Victory at last! - You are now able to complete the victory into space mission.
At the end of the mission it will also give you a game score that I plan to create a steam leaderboard for.
The score system is currently a work in progress and will not be working until after I move the game difficulty settings to be fixed for the whole game.

[u]FIRST PASS BETTER ART![/u]
I have started the initial phases of character art re-sampling.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/d95d191250df3061ac2f21ac9cc7e53f80b867f2.jpg[/img]

This will be a long process, at the moment there are only a few updates and these are to female characters only. Over time I will redo the 100's of items that are currently in the game as well as the faces and hair.
I look to add a few improvements with each update as we move forwards.

[u]OTHER POINTS OF INTEREST![/u]
[b]Just a Scratch![/b]
If your character has only lost a few hit points then they will just have a scratch and not pick up a wounded condition if they go into a fight.

[b]Boss AutoSave[/b]
On game difficulty settings of Standard or below, the game will automatically save as you enter boss fights.

[b]Settlement Attack - Character Health[/b]
Until now, if a Settlement was attacked and your characters had less than 50% health, they were healed up to 50%.
Now on Hard and Challenging game settings, this free heal has been removed.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added: Various items needed to build the spaceship.
[*]Added: Plotbook updates
[*]Added: Autosave on boss fights for Standard Difficulty and below
[*]Added: Just a scratch damage condition
[*]Unlocked: Astronomy 9
[*]Unlocked: Astronomy 10

[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed: The Rare item: Leather tunic has been buffed.
[*]Changed: The free heal before a settlement fight.
[*]Changed: Character Art work sampling
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: The Blight 8 Plotline was not unlocking.
[*]Fixed: An issue with the HP text
[*]Fixed: An issue with the copper mine adventure disapearing
[/list]

Follow Settlements now on Twitter: @Treongames

notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Settlements update 0.11.6[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/8793c59367298faa4e0c3492fb4852ec1105af7f.jpg[/img]
[b]The Production Menu![/b]
The production menu is now live.
To menu can be opened from the main menupanel on the left hand side of the game.
This menu has the following features.
[list]
[*]Right Click a Character to view/change equipment
[*]Select and change machinery. - The window will go red if the machinery is not powered.
[*]Select item recipe, research or factory greenprint creation.
[*]Select multi-run or single run.
[*]Select a set quantity to run, up to a max of 999
[*]View how many of each material you have stored for every crafting recipe.
[*]Select a follow on recipe that will take over when the 1st recipe completes. (If the first recipe is on Multi-Run INF qty, then this will never happen!)
[*]Select multi-run, single run and qty for the follow on recipe.
[/list]
This will give you complete control over your production from a single menu.

[list]

notes.title: Update 0.11.5 goes live!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Settlements update 0.11.5[/h1]
There are quite a few new features as well as the usual patch notes.
The new features are:

[b]Game Difficulty Settings[/b]
There are not 5 difficulty settings that can be selected from the options menu.
[list]
[*][b]Gentle[/b]
Cannot lose due to Doom
Easier Boss Fights
Less chance of scouts being attacked
More money from treasure
Better merchant prices
Reduced chance of Rare or Ultra rare loot
[*][b]Easy[/b]
Reduced doom risk
Slightly Easier Boss Fights
Less chance of scouts being attacked
Slightly more money from treasure
Better merchant prices
Less chance of Rare or Ultra rare loot
[*][b]Standard[/b]
No change from current play
[*][b]Hard[/b]
More chance of Settlement attacks
Slightly Harder Boss Fights
More chance of scouts being attacked
Slightly less money from treasure
Slightly poorer merchant prices
More chance of Rare or Ultra rare loot
[*][b]Challenging[/b]
Quicker build up of enemy at Settlements
Harder Boss Fights
More chance of scouts being attacked
Less money from treasure
Poorer merchant prices
Good chance of Rare or Ultra rare loot
[/list]

[b]Injured Characters[/b]
Characters will now carry wounds between battles.
If they go into combat while injured, they will suffer the following effects.
[list]
[*]Wounded:  
Melee -5 to hit 
Ranged -5 to hit 
Hard Mode or Challenging: -5 Melee Defence
[*]Broken: 
Melee -20 to hit 
Ranged -10 to hit 
Hard Mode or Challenging:  -10 Melee Defence
[*]Incapacitated:  
Melee- 40 to hit
Ranged -20 to hit
Hard Mode or Challenging:  -15 Melee Defence
[/list]

[b]New world skill: Militia Recruitment[/b]
You will require this skill now if you wish to have more than 1 militia defending your settlement.
The amount of militia differs per difficulty level you are playing on.
Gentle: Max = 6
Easy: Max = 5
Standard: Max = 4
Hard: Max is still 4 just harder to aquire.
Challenging: Max is 3

[b]New Rare world skill: Logical Thinking[/b]
This skill can only be gained from scouting missions.
It increases the amount of science output in the science lab.

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*]Added: 5 Game Difficulty Settings.
[*]Added: New world skill Militia Recruitment
[*]Added: New world skill Logical Thinking
[*]Added: Missile Defence System now works in combat.
[*]Added: Militia damage tooltips (Can be seen in combat).
[*]Added: Rare Scouting return: Knowledge skills.
[*]Added: Output text when a craft building completes its item.
[*]Added: Character wounds.
[*]Added: An option for extra combat text. (combat text has been cleaned up).
[*]Added: More xp for Logical Thinking from completing Science fields.
[*]Added: Hit points and condition to the character tooltip when in a settlement.
[*]Unlocked: Science Lab Field - Energy 7 + items
[*]Unlocked: Science Lab Field - Energy 8 + items
[*]Unlocked: Science Lab Field - Energy 9 + items
[*]Unlocked: Science Lab Field - Energy 10 + items
[*]Unlocked: Science Lab Field - Computers 7 + items
[/list]

[b]Changed[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed: The treasure generation system has been redone.
[*]Changed: The amount of militia you have is now based upon the Militia recruitment skill.
[*]Changed: Loading tip for warrior reading health when it should read Hit Points.
[*]Changed: Chosenman rifle can now be equipped in melee as with other rifles.
[*]Changed: The way quester times are calculated
[*]Changed: Treasure from quester unlocks should be available instantly now, instead of waiting for the questers to return.
[*]Changed: Calculation and display of power changes when you equip new engines
[*]Changed: Some artwork changes to make the characters look better
[*]Changed: Combat text output and colours to make combat text more useful.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: An issue with the Spider Queen not healing correctly.
[*]Fixed: Scout screen not showing correctly if double clicked.
[*]Fixed: Issue with MA Wasp not giving xp.
[*]Fixed: Issue with MA Wasp unlocking incorrectly.
[*]Fixed: Missing health on the health clinic.
[*]Fixed: An issue where 2 Kyals could spawn in combat.
[*]Fixed: Other minor spawning issue.
[*]Fixed: Issues with the sound effects.
[*]Fixed: Several Cosmetic issues.
[*]Fixed: A rare bub that could cause a draw error or a missing character when a new person is spawned.
[*]Fixed: An arithmatic overflow in the science lab
[*]Fixed: An issue with some questers being gone a lot time
[*]Fixed: The game would incorrectly unpause when you came back fom the main menu
[*]Fixed: A display issue with militia turning up outside of defence battles.
[*]Fixed: Nuclear engines not giving any power
[/list]

[b]Game Difficulty Changes[/b]
[*][b]Gentle[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced the amount of enemy that spawn in combat
[/list]

[*][b]Standard[/b]
[list]
[*]Standard hit chance in combat is 75%
[/list]

[*][b]Hard[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed massing rules so that monsters do not start to mass until settlement threat is higher
[*]All Monsters have +5 armour
[*]Standard hit chance in combat is 70%
[*]Better treasure in new treasure system
[/list]

[*][b]Challenging[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed massing rules so that monsters do not start to mass until settlement threat is higher
[*]All Monsters have +10 armour
[*]Standard hit chance in combat is 65%
[*]Some monsters now have a chance to heal themselves
[*]Better treasure in new treasure system
[/list]


[i]Hear it first at
Twitter: @treongames[/i]

notes.title: SETTLEMENTS Update: ERA 10 - Victory or Death!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/c06ca2927aacbf02b5cf47f318e2589ae842e9b0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Welcome to the start of ERA 10 content.[/h1]
Today's patch will open the way into ERA 10 and more content will be released throughout June.
ERA 10 is different from every other era.
There will be a lot less building/item creation but more focus on the 3 seperate storylines, adventure quests and victorys that can be achieved.
As we progress into ERA10, you will have to decide upon how you will try to end your game.
[list]
[*]Make peace with the Blight Entity!
[*]Destroy the Blight Entity!
[*]or Flee the planet and save as many people as possible.
[/list]

Here are the patch notes for today's release.
Enjoy!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added: Questline - The Awakening
[*]Added: Reward Item - Merlin's Staff to Era 4+ treasure

[*]Added: 2 rare boss encounter spawns for the Headhunter brothers.
[*]Added: New loot for the Headhunter brothers.

[*]Unlocked: Rocketry 7
[*]Unlocked: Rocketry 8

When you get there, you can move people in but there is nothing for you to do as yet - this will be in one of the ERA 10 victory questlines.

[i]Tormunda - Settlements Developer[/i]: User engagement was very important when I developed business software and now that I am designing games, community engagement is key.

Here are just some of the Community Requests added to date.
[list]
[*]A way to invite new characters to move in, rather than auto-spawn.
[*]Voice Volume option.
[*]Ability to set which food can be used to heal.(new AI fixes this)
[*]Better Starting stat randomization. (Ability to delete has been removed- stats have been redone).
[*]Highlight current settlement in the quickbar
[*]Ability to view both common and fine resources at the same time on the tracker bar.
[*]Hovering over the Character Statistics should show a list of skills they effect.
[*]Reduce OP of Healing Teeth.
[*]Lower Randomness in combat Initiative.
[*]Pause using the Space bar.
[*]Change Era 2 homes to use meat, using Fruit and Veg confusing.
[*]Ability to Speed up combat.
[*]Move Misc items from their own slot, onto the main advanced slots in combat.
[*]Settlement threat ToolTip to offer more help! 
[*]Settlement  Selector across bottom of main screen
[*]Make background sounds, more background!
[*]Use +/- to increase/descrease game speed
[*]Use ESC to get to the main menu.
[*]Production and Supply tooltips
[*]Set characters who switch out to reserve to be on auto-heal.
[*]GUI Flowchart of buildings - with links. (Tech Tree!)
[*]Boss Spawn mechanics - Bosses spawning too often.
[*]Ability to adjust font size
[*]Character List-out with filters and options to equip.
[*]Ability to auto-equip some items (moved this here as the above idea may provide the solution).
[*]Make Scouting feature more obvious to new players. [i]Added a scout to next settlement bar to highlight what is required and how far to go.[/i]
[*]More assistance for Dagger / Fist users to allow Dexer DPS to be more viable.  - [i]new daggers and duel wielding added[/i]
[*]Characters highlighted in combat when it is their action.
[*]Ability to name your Settlements
[*]Ability to hide helmets. (toggle)
[*]Ability to sell set numbers to merchants.
[*]Put bottom end on Chest Era when getting treasure.
[*]Add navigation options in the Central Plot.
[*]Add character navigation options in the feats section.
[*]Increase the duration of tooltips.
[*]Too many menus! Consolidate some into others.
[*]Better Status for unarmed items.
[*]More resource tracking slots.
[*]Auto pause on loading.
[*]Better Doom details.
[*]Better Scouting
[*]Show Xp on World Skills.
[*]Game Wiki
[*]Better empty equipment descriptions.
[*]Better homeless system.
[*]Better move character system.
[*]Late era tools.
[/list]

notes.title: SETTLEMENTS - End Game Roadmap Details
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/5b559343c2682ee91fc7aa1cd2f121c79ea2bfa5.jpg[/img]

Hi, progress on the game is coming along nicely and I thought it was a good time to outline what is due to come next.

[h1]Roadmap![/h1]

[b]ERA9[/b] (May)
[list]
[*]Nuclear Energy - Completed
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/8fc4d70bcb5fdc3cccd6ec0d43bc296964c6dd65.jpg[/img]
[*]Bio-Lab - Completed
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/05d69f8157acab29be81be31e29fe794dbb7e2eb.jpg[/img]
[*]Rocketry 
An Adventure Quest, building, several plot updates and items required.
[*]The Awakening
This is the start of the Blight waking independent of the doom status. As it awakens, the end game (era 10) will start.
[*]Bio- Ranged
There are several ranged weapons and some more melee weapons to come in era 9
[*]Advanced Armour
There is another Light and Heavy suit to come in Era 9.
[/list]

You are currently able to get to Blight Level 8.
This reveals the first two ways to win the game and gives you some goals to work towards.

[b]ERA10[/b] (June)
[list]
[*]End Game - No spoilers here!
[*]In ERA10 there are several more updates to computers, engines, energy cells and most of all the items needed to perform one of the 3 end game victory conditions.
[*]Settlement 10 will only be revealed when you try to complete 1 of these end game conditions.
[*]There are more weapons and armour options in ERA10, however if you have the time and infrastructure to make these will be based upon your actions in ERA10 and how well you prepared before leaving Era 9.
[*]And finally, Coffee! How can all your people be working so hard without Coffee! :)
[/list]

[b]Polish[/b] (as long as it takes!)
[list]
[*]I am constantly working on the various interfaces. Feedback and ideas are always welcome.
Note: I do aim to try and reduce some of them as we have far too many at the moment.
[*]Some better crafting controls are required.
[*]Better faces and the ability for you to add your own faces into the game will require a launch or post launch tool.
[*]More rare treasure drops and adventure quests.
[*]Artwork, tasks, sounds, animation. There are a whole host of part finished or missing animations in the game. These will be addressed closer to launch.
[*]Bug fixing and Balance - This is a priority at all times from now until launch.
[*]Hard Mode. Only once bug fixing and balance has been nailed down will i work on the hard mode changes.
[/list]



[h1]Latest Patch Notes for 0.10.5[/h1]

In the latest update you will need to resave your game settings in the options menu. (Auto Fill etc).

[list]
[*]Added:  New scouting system.
[*]Added:  New Achievements for 10,30 & 60 Tasks completed.

[*]Fixed: Added Fine Riot shield outcome.

[*]Hotfix: Fixed several Scouting issues.

notes.title: Settlements Hotfix
notes.content:
I am releasing a hotfix for some issues that came with the last update and also adding a few changes that should make for better gameplay.

[list]
[*]Moving people between Settlements broke last update - that has been fixed.
If you had any missing people, they will appear on a reload.
[*]The Goliath encounter will now appear if you have Settlement 6 as well as if you are looking for it. (This will make sure the Science Lab unlocks).
[*]The Game now auto pauses on load and during tutorial popups
[*]I have slightly reduced the chance of staging areas in Era 8
[*]I have slightly increased the chance of helping people quests in Era 8 to allow for more Doom control.
[*]I have added a tooltip to the doom clock to help explain how it works
[*]I have changed the name of the doom clock to doom status. A clock implies that it is moving based on time.
[*]I have slightly increased the base speed in which combat plays at, without the speed button being used.
[/list]

notes.title: Settlements: Come join the fight!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/2005bfa772ea0ba6ec84bcd4d6ae87f19b1fa860.jpg[/img]
[h1]Settlements Era 9[/h1]
Players end era 8 with some understanding of what they are up against but lack the knowledge and equipment they need to do anything about it.
Era 9 will be a make or break point for the player. 
It brings their civilisations technology up to modern day, knowing full well that humanity lost the fight before when they had billions of people and the player only has a handfull.
The blight brain will begin to full awaken and see the threat at hand. As such the strength and frequency of attacks will increase as it prepares for a final solution to mankind.
Settlements has many players with 400+ hours of playtime already and there is still 20%+ more content to come.
Come join us now in our last stand!

(Patch Notes below)

[b]Bio Weapons are now available.[/b]
When used against creatures that are not part of the blight, they will do less damage than others of the same era. However against the blight they will do great damage depending upon how much affinity the creature has to the blight.
It is a good idea to have some bio weapons in the group, but maybe not so good to equip everyone with them!

[b]Grenades.[/b]
Grenades are equipped in the misc slot and can be thrown at the back line of enemy.

[b]Negative Health.[/b]
Several buildings and locations now have a negative health.

[b]Settlement 9 and Era 9[/b]
It is now possible to find Settlement 9 and advance to Era 9, although there is currently only 1 item and 1 building in that era and the monsters will be harder! - So advance at your own risk.

notes.title: Settlements Update: 0.9.7
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/696b6fc33131f975faea1ab2bae366bdf6643cc3.jpg[/img]
This update has many core changes and quality of life updates!

Lets start with
[b]Adventure Quests![/b]
They are now live. Although not many as yet there are 2 very key ones that unlock Bio-Chemistry and allow you to get the chemist skill.
This alone will unlock a lot of content that is already released but was stuck behind this skill.
The Adventure Quest system has been updated. You now have to select actions in each location and based upon your skill the map will either update or not.
There are 3 Adventure Quests in this release. 2 Storyline only and 1 fixed to era 3-4. I will release more as we move forward.

[b]Game Setting Options[/b]
The first of which has been much asked for - The ability to set all crafting to be be multi-run by default. (this will not affect research on world skills).
The second option is a game changer!
Ability to turn off the Auto Character Spawn!
Yes that is right. You can now set it so that when you would normally get a new character (on housing upgrades or character death), you now get an icon at the top of each settlement allowing you to spawn a new character where and when you wish.
This brings us neatly onto the next major change.

[b]Homeless Characters[/b]
These have been totally changed. Once a character becomes homeless they no longer start to die. Instead they just hang around!
They are unable to work do research or quest.
They will defend the settlement but they fight at strength.
However this now does give you total control over house management when building houses and not wanting to spawn more characters.
And if that was not enough...

[b]Character Movement between Settlement![/b]
The old system has gone. Yay! 
Now you can just pick up and drop a character onto any of the settlement pictures and they will relocate to that settlement, even if there are no available houses.
Each settlement now has a maximum population it can hold, it is up to you if they are all homeless or not!

[h1]Full patch notes below[/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Bio-Chem Adventure Quest Unlock 1
[*]Bio-Chem Adventure Quest Unlock 2
[*]General Adventure Quest: Era 3-4
[*]New monster/artwork/sounds
[*]Added a pause icon to the main panel, it acts the same as the space bar pause. This allows you to play almost totally by mouse if needed.
[*]Added a multi-run option in settings: This will set all crafting to be multi run by default if selected.
[*]Adventure Quests to the main update pages.
[*]Adventure Quest Icon on the main game page.
[*]Settings option: No AutoFill
You can not opt to turn autofill on houses off. Once off you will need to click on a spawn character icon in each settlement if you wish that settlement to have a new character.
[*]Added ability to turn on and off food fill in the science lab. It will still use the food you have stored there.
[*]Several new items
[*]New recipes
[*]New scrapbook updates
[*]Blight level 4
[*]The Spore Plague
[*]Text glow to the selected settlement on the settlement picture bar
[*]Settlement Max population. Each Settlement now has it's own population cap.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Homeless changes!
Homeless can no longer work, research or quest: Homeless no longer take no-home damage. They fight at 1/2 strength if defending the settlement.
[*]Labcoat and Fine labcoat to have higher Science skills when worn.
[*]Staging areas: Now if you lose or flee from the fight, the staging area will move to a new location.
[*]Moveing Settlements.
You can now drag and drop characters onto the settlement picture bar to move them.
[*]Removed: Exchange Settlement Option.
[*]Removed: Delete Character option.
[*]Increased the amount of coin dropped by higher difficulty bosses.
[*]Combat reserve healing. Basic healing is fixed at 5hp a turn and 10hp when set to full heal
[*]Changed Riot shield to use Compisite materials instead of Plastics
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Error with people in the ScienceLab not returning from quests - they are not allowed to quest.
[*]Fixed: An issue with changing people in combat
[*]Fixed: Issue with Rifle criticals.
[*]Fixed an issue with enemy reserve HP's not showing correctly when shot by frontline troops.
[*]Fixed incorrect display and update of science lab output.
[/list]

Follow Settlement on:
[i]Settlements@TreonGames[/i]
[i]https://www.facebook.com/TreonGames/[/i]

notes.title: SETTLEMENTS 0.9.6 Goes Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/fa6e72ad067be6324e65ffa2771e7e29ad382fc6.jpg[/img]

Hello Settlements Players!
This update brings a lot of fixes as well as some nice new content.
The main parts of which are:
[b]TASKS[/b]

What are tasks you ask? Well they are a nice way for me to tackle 2 major issues we currently have.
1) A guide and tips for new players - the task system allows me to lay out some steps to walk a new player through the first age. It also allows me to explan what each other age should be focusing on and reassuring players that some stress points are supposed to be there.
2) A great way to get Coin. I am always asked for more ways to get coin, especially early in the game - well here it is.

On top of that, the task system is a great way to give yourself mini-goals while you are in each game Age and get a reward for doing so.

[b]Better Food AI[/b]

Food and healing have been a major talking point since release. I know that many of you have asked for a new interface to manage food, however I am reluctant to add more interfaces for users to navigate through unless there is no other choice.
To this end I have changed the way the AI looks at food to better manage if they need food and what food to use. 

[b]Combat Threat[/b]

When fights get very tough, it is only by managing threat that you can get out with everyone alive.
However, understanding threat and why 1 character is getting beaten up when others are being ignored is not always easy.
To this end I have added a toggle button on the combat screen that will allow you to turn on/off the display of threat values against each of your characters.
This should allow you to see what threat your actions are causing and better manage who is getting attacked in those challenging fights.

[b]Please follow Settlements on Twitter for all the latest news: [/b]Settlements@TreonGames

Enjoy!

[h1]Full patch notes below[/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added TASKS! - Each Age now has tasks that can be completed for coin or items. There are currently only tasks for AGE 1 - 6 (7-8 to follow)
[*]Added AGE tips and info - on the task screen
[*]New animation for the log cabin build.
[*]The option to see Combat Threat has been added to the combat screen. You can toggle this on and off with a button at the top right. It will display the current threat value on each monster so that you can better manage threat in difficult fights.
[*]Added a Character has fully healed output text
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed skill removal to be free (Yes you read that correctly.... FREE!)
[*]Changed healing - Healing food AI has been redone. Characters should now better choose which foods to eat.
[*]Changed healing - Characters will now automatically gain at least 1 health per tick, even if no food and not at home.
[*]Changed 'character of settlement x' to be 'character of settlement-name' in text output
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a loading issue if a game was saved with no characters
[*]Better memory clearance on reloads (There is still a small memory creep when reloading a save again and again - if you have an issue, please restart the client and then load). However you should see a huge performance increase from before
[*]Fixed an issue with Incorrect plot plants showing
[*]Fixed an issue when obtaining a new fine version resource, it would add itself to the tracker bar even if the basic resource was already added
[*]Fixed an issue with huts not auto restarting after a reload
[*]Fixed an issue with text size for feats - they should now display better on various screen sizes
[*]Fixed an issue where deleting a building was removing the plant artwork
[*]Fixed an issue where some character combat buffs were not clearing after combat
[*]Fixed and changed the display of %chance of a scout being ambushed.
[*]Fixed an issue with the lab coat tooltip
[*]Cleaned up some minor combat errors
[/list]

notes.title: Open beta - 0.9.4.3
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]The ability to rename your Settlement has been added. There is a 'Name' Button next to the Settlement name on the right hand panel. - Settlements have been given default names based on where they were found.
[*]Added the ability to Sell to Merchants in quantities of 10.
[*]2 New feats have been added to allow you to purchase more Hit Points.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Layout and GUI changes to the merchant interface.
[*]The Doomclock has been set to a minimum level based upon the current Era. This is in line with the main story, as it is your advancement that is awakening the unknown enemy. 
[*]Updated the Stats tooltips to show the new skills.
[*]Hit points have been recalculated. Anyone with less than 400 HP will see no difference, however characters with very large amount of kills or damage taken will see a reduced bonus from these 2 values. There is still no limit on Extra HP's but they are now harder to obtain. (2 New feats have been added to help boost HP's if you have the coin!)
[*]Changed the text display for large numbers on the character sheets. They will now change to x.xx K for 1000's and x.xx M for Millions.
[*]Changed the Character view to not close the Quest menu when it is closed.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the Options buttons being black on some computers.
[*]Fixed an issue with some buttons were not showing when switching between Scouting, Science and Quests.
[/list]

notes.title: Open Beta - 0.9.3.8 - Bug Fixes and Boss Difficulty.
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]

A few issues today around scouting and characters due to a change in the code. Sorry for any issues.

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Boss Difficulty.
Bosses now scale in difficulty based upon your Era.
You may also opt to increase the difficulty.
The ranged of difficulty only go up to +5 and cannot go below the adjusted value of your era modification.
[*]Ultra-Rare Items.
Bosses with added difficulty will now have a chance to drop an ultra-rare item.

Note: Only the Rat King and Wolfman are currently set to have difficulty.

[*]Added skill notes for the new skills.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Slightly adjusted settlement attack frequency
[*]Adjusted the chance of a scout getting ambushed.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where sending a character away while they were in the overflow area, would create a doppleganger.
[*]Fixed an issue where sending a character scouting from the central plot would create a doppleganger.
[/list]

notes.title: Open Beta 0.8.12 - Cure for the Monday Blues!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/8a6a10a6bdde4c6810d6c73a07a925ba8e112670.jpg[/img]
[h1]UPDATES[/h1]
Era 7 is Coming to an End! (Settlement 7 and Oil is getting closer)
Below I bring you the last items of Era 7 as well as duel wielding and the ability to use rifles in melee (as well as bug fixes and polish)

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Duel Wielding!
You can now wield a Dagger or a Pistol weapon in your ranged/shield slot. In combat you will gain 1 extra standard attack with that weapon.
[*]Added: Kevlar Armour Recipe
[*]Added: Heavy kevlar Armour Recipe
[*]Added: Kevlar Helmet Recipe
[*]Added: Heavy Kevlar Helmet Recipe
[*]Added: Observatory Recipe
[*]Added Science Lab: Astronomy 5 unlock.
[*]Added Science Lab: Astronomy 6 unlock.
[*]Added Science Lab: Composites 1 unlock.
[*]Added Science Lab: Composites 2 unlock.
[*]Added some new monsters for era 5-7
[*]Added more weather events.
[*]Added some monsters only attacking based on weather.
[*]Added 2 Era 7 Rare treasure drops.
[*]Added new sounds and animations.
[*]Added more tooltips
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Rifles, Muskets etc can now be used as a melee weapon.
Once in the melee slot, you cannot use shields or other ranged weapons. However you can block with the rifle and shoot at any enemy, without penalty. (Including reserves).
Also if you switch to your reserves, your front rank character armed with a rifle in melee, will automatically use the rifle from the reserve location.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with quest creation/allocation.
[*]Fixed the jarring effect when resizing the game.
[*]Fixed the jarring effect when a boss dies in combat.
[*]Fixed an issue with coin qty being produced in factories. Critical was giving the wrong quantity.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Science Lab consuming food when no research was being done.
[*]Fixed the locks on Ballistics - you are not supposed to be able to research later than the Mortar Launcher.
[*]Fixed an issue with the werewolves not showing up in era 7.
[*]Fixed an issue where the central plot build would get bugged if you did not clear a build before selecting a new one.
[*]Fixed an issue with Lab Coats not giving Science skill bonus.
[*]Fixed display error saying ranged were at -25 to hit even when they were not shooting into combat.
[/list]

[h1]UPDATES[/h1]
Era 7 is Coming to an End! (Settlement 7 and Oil is getting closer)
Below I bring you the last items of Era 7 as well as duel wielding and the ability to use rifles in melee (as well as bug fixes and polish)

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Duel Wielding!
You can now wield a Dagger or a Pistol weapon in your ranged/shield slot. In combat you will gain 1 extra standard attack with that weapon.
[*]Added: Kevlar Armour Recipe
[*]Added: Heavy kevlar Armour Recipe
[*]Added: Kevlar Helmet Recipe
[*]Added: Heavy Kevlar Helmet Recipe
[*]Added: Observatory Recipe

[*]Added Science Lab: Composites 1 unlock.
[*]Added Science Lab: Composites 2 unlock.
[*]Added some new monsters for era 5-7

[*]Added 2 Era 7 Rare treasure drops.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Rifles, Muskets etc can now be used as a melee weapon.
Once in the melee slot, you cannot use shields or other ranged weapons. However you can block with the rifle and shoot at any enemy, without penalty. (Including reserves).
Also if you switch to your reserves, your front rank character armed with a rifle in melee, will automatically use the rifle from the reserve location.

[*]Fixed an issue with the Science Lab consuming food when no research was being done.

[*]Fixed an issue with the werewolves not showing up in era 7.
[*]Fixed an issue where the central plot build would get bugged if you did not clear a build before selecting a new one.

notes.title: Open Beta 0.8.11
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/278f271f333f47547387205c1a473a907293cc3f.jpg[/img]
This week brings you the single most community requested item so far:
[i]The Character Lister[/i]. 
Today releases the first pass on this request. Future updates will add the ability to view/sort/filter by strength/dex etc as well as kills/damage.
At the moment the only sort/filter you have is by settlement - however i am sure you will find this of huge help.

For those of you who have powered through content and are itching for a new enemy, I bring you [i]Whiteout[/i]. A huge snowbeast that brings with him special weather effects.

Speaking of weather!
You now have the possibility of weather in combat.
Overcast = No bad effects. But can change to rain!
Raining = -10 Ranged, -5 Melee Defence. - Can change to Overcast.
Snowing = -25 Ranged.


[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Character Lister Beta 1:  On the bottom of the menu panel there is now an icon with WIP (work in progress) on it for the community requested Character List. There is a lot more to come on this list, with functions to display abilities and stats. However you are welcome to start using the lister right away and make use of this great new tool).
[*]Era 6 Boss Whiteout is now available and the Achievement has been unlocked! - Enjoy.
[*]Added 3 New special boss items to go with the Whiteout combat.
[*]Double healing! When a character is in their house they will now get double healing. - You can send characters home via the 'send home' button in the new Character Lister.
[*]Weather effects.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Spending Diplomacy on Clearing Settlement threat will now drop the threat to 0. However it will climb back up faster depending on what Era you are currently in.
[*]Defeating Staging areas can now reduce a settlement threat back to 0. (although it may take several staging areas to do this!)
[*]Pressing ESC from the world map will now take you to the main menu.
[*]Tweeked a few recipe costs.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue whereby it was possible to research Chemistry 11 and cause a game crash.
[*]Fixed a graphics display issue where the wrong terrain could show in combat.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause quests to become lost.
[*]Fixed an issue where it was possible to unlock a higher settlement and then gain access to the lower settlements, even if they were locked.
[*]Fixed many GUI and text issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Open Beta 0.8.10.13 - Content Tweeks and Bug fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/6f6f4a59c511fada61d85404b07d090fcb8f31a0.jpg[/img]
Hi and thank you all for being here for week 1 Early Access.
It has had its bugs and I hope this latest patch will put an end to the last major ones. There are a lot of smaller issues that need fixing and many interface upgrades and options required to bring a better gaming experience for you all.
Please continue to report any bugs you find. 
[h1]UPDATES[/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]8 New items, 3 new recipes. Added a few items that will allow for a better progression.
[/list]

Changes
[list]
[*]All equipment will now have 2 options for requirements - skill or stat. Example: This will allow strong people to use armour even if they do not have the warrior skill.
[/list]

Bugs 
[list]
[*]Fixed several threat level issues
[*]Fixed an issue with Botany era 5 worldskill recipe.
[*]Fixed many settlement 5 issues, the shades should not attack now unless you are using the settlement and any combat loss there should not revert the central plot to normal housing if caves were open. - A script has been put into the load to fix anyones game that had these issues, if so you will need to reclose the caves and any central plot building you made will be gone.
[*]Fixed an issue that would allow you to be attacked when at peace.
[*]Fixed an issue where it was possible to go negative doom - I will be adding a bonus to treasure to anyone who keeps doom at 0 in a future patch.
[*]Fixed some achievement issues.
[*]Fixed an issue where quests would not show on the map.
[*]Fixed some minor GUI issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Open Beta 0.8.10.12
notes.content:
Welcome to the first week of Early Access update.
The first week has been a busy week. A lot of updates and changes. Even so I have managed to get together a few nice changes for the weekend.
The game start should be smoother now and a test tech tree is also available in the era 1 building view.
I am working on a Discord server for the community and more updates and content. 
Until then, enjoy:

[h1]UPDATES[/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Settlement Selector. - There are now a row of settlement images across the base of the Settlement screen, to allow for quick selection.
[*]numberpad +/- will now trigger increase or descrease in game speed.
[*]Esc will now take you to the main menu from the village or world screens.
[*]Changed Era 1 building view to be a tech tree. This is a test. Please give feedback. - The normal building menu and era 2 + works as before.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the start of the game so that you can build up without having to jump through tutorial hoops! - The start should be much smoother.
[*]Improved the quality of the settlement images on the world map.
[*]Improved some GUI issues.
[*]Improved the speed of standard combat.
[*]Cleared down the output text panel when starting a new game.
[*]Changed the difficulty in finding Settlement 3 to be easy, however you will still have to overcome the [i]Wolf Pack[/i].
[*]Set a max payment for a single item from the merchants to 2kc
[*]Added some minor doom clock reduction for killing a boss.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Plot tooltip when a building is under construction no longer says 'Central Plot'.
[*]Fixed an issue where you could click off the first tutorial pop-up and make the shack appear in early bronze age.
[*]Fixed an issue where it was possible to send 'ghost' questers on missions that would block the mission slots.
[*]Fixed an error report that would occur if you changed some crafting to research without clearing it. - the error report was false.
[*]Fied an issue where Supply was not calculating correcting and in some cases was using too many of your resources
[*]Fixed the missing tooltip on the Healing Clinic and Hospital.
[*]Fixed an incorrect skill gain when crafting the Flail.
[*]Fixed a possible negative resource count.
[*]Removed the adventure quest skills from locked chests.
[*]Fixed a scout quest error that would place the quest icon in the wrong location.
[*]Fixed a loophole that would allow you to go into negative diplomacy.
[/list]

notes.title: Open Beta - 0.8.10.9 - Bug Fixed and Tweaks
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATES[/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Thanks to the idea from community member [i]Nails[/i].
I have added extra information to the item tracker bar. Now, if an item has a rare version of itself, it will list that in gold along with the common version. Beyond the ability to track both versions of the item when crafting, you also get to see if the item does not have a rare version.
[*]Thanks to the idea from community member [i]Nails[/i].
I have added a tooltip to each stat in the character sheet that will display the main skills and effects of that stat. The stats are used in many places throughout the game beyond what is listed, however these are the key areas. As more skills are added I will update the list. 
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]In the Character sheet I have changed the text 'Targets' on melee and ranged weapons to now show '1st Special'. This value is the skill level in the weapon that you need in order to unlock the 1st Advanced move of that weapon. (Some weapons have a 2nd and 3rd Advanced move).
Sometimes it is better to keep a faster, lower Era and lower damage weapon, if you have the skill to master it, than advance to a weapon that is difficult to master.
[*]Changed references in the skill descriptions to say Dexterity instead of Agility.
[*]Increased the damage on the Silver Longblade to be more inline with it's rarity. However the damage is still lower than some weapons of it's era due to it's main strength being such a low Threat value. (this make the weapon a poor choice for a tank and great for a support).
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that caused custom character titles not to work.
[*]Fixed an issue where your researcher could lose a build if they gave up researching the current item. (if you had this issue, there is a script that will restore the lost building when you load the game with the new build).
[*]I have fixed several New Game issues when starting a new game from a game already in progress. (This should be safe to do now without you having to restart the application).
[*]Fixed some minor display issues.
[*]Fixed an issue where the game speed of 0 did not continue to pause the game when other pause/unpause events triggered.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Spotlight - Adventure Quests
notes.content:
[h1]Adventure Quests[/h1]

Welcome to our first development spotlight. This is where I get the chance to show you what is currently being worked on.

Adventure Quests are something I have spoken about a few times but not given any real information, so here it is.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/181e0918921cfb5b497dbb62977e9d67412cd449.jpg[/img]

There are rules for Adventure Quests that I will list first.
[list]
[*]They are a chain of encounters that must be completed or abandoned before you can continue with the main game.
Battles will be had, skills will be tested and healing will be used up!
[*]Unless you find a location that allows you to restock your combat healing skill, you will have to make your combat heals last for the whole adventure.
[*]Hit points will carry on from encounter to encounter. If you are lucky, you may find a location that heals you!
[*]Character skills will be used to decide what you find in each location or if you can pass through a location.
[*]New skills will be added to the game to allow you to create a special adventuring party.
[*]Light source items will be added to the game to allow you to fight underground without penalty. (or less of a penalty)
[*]Not all adventures will be underground.
[*]Some quests may be just a few rooms, some may be very large.
[*]They will be keyed to expire at a certain Era. This will allow you to test your best characters against the toughest adventures of a given Era.
[*]Unless otherwise stated, each adventure can only be completed once per game.
[*]You will unlock new adventures via several means: Random Scouting, Random Events, Set conditions, Automatic.
[*]There will be special treasure or key quest updates at the end of each adventure.
[*]There may often be more than 1 way through an adventure. The room pictures will fill in as you complete them, but you can always backtrack and go another way.
[/list]

[b]When are they due?[/b]
Well that is the big question. They are still in development and after a period of testing I will release 1 or 2 basic adventures to allow for you all to test and give feedback.

[b]Why are these the next item you are working on?[/b]
Before I can allow anyone to unlock Bio-Chemistry in the Science Lab I need a quest mechanic to help drive the storyline. This system will be ideal. Once it is tested I can move on to allow you to research Bio-Chemistry, which along with Settlement 7 (The Oil Pump)  will make way for you all to play through ERA 8. 

[b]Will there be Adventure Achievements?[/b]
I will probably add some for total adventures completed and maybe a few special ones for extremely difficult quests.

tags.feature: New skills will be added to the game to allow you to create a special adventuring party.
Light source items will be added to the game to allow you to fight underground without penalty. (or less of a penalty)

notes.title: Closed Beta T8.10.6 - Tweeks and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATES[/h1]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced the Healing Teeth combat heal to 8.
[*]The requirements for the Maintenance building were incorrect.
[*]Corrected the Botany recipe, it should have been Era 5 not 6.
[*]Added plot update sparkles to the Goliath mission
[*]Changed Goliath's position on the combat screen.
[*]Reduced threat slightly when using combat heal.
[*]Increased effectiveness of Taunt feats.
[*]Increased the amount of Combat Heals available per battle to Intellect * 2 + Combat Heal skill.
[*]Changed treasure - the items you get will now be from era 1 up to the current era, instead of just current era. This includes skillbook types.
[*]Scouts now also get their Intellect and Dexterity added to avoiding being attacked when out scouting.
[*]Changed the skill to use on various bows to be archery instead of warrior and altered a few restrictions on ranged items.
[*]Some text and art changes.
[*]Changed the steel sheet to also be able to be made in the steel refinery
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a rare combat crash due to threat calculation.
[*]Fixed an issue with the wrong ancient data store showing on some slayer deeds.
[*]Fixed a crash when building stone guardhouses.
[*]Cleaned up the pit trap images on grass.
[*]Fixed an issue where it was possible to get your own hands and feet in a treasure chest.... best not to ask!!!
[*]Fixed a loading error when a character was left in an exchange slot.
[*]Fixed an issue where dead characters could block an exchange slot.
[*]Fixed an issue where if your stone guardhouse was damaged, the central plot would error.
[*]Fixed some central plot text issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Beta T8.10 - Combat Update
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATES[/h1]
[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Stances!
You can now set a combat stance for each frontline character. Changing stance does not take up your action. The stances are:
Attack: +5 To-hit and +2 Max damage, -5 Block and -5 Melee Defence. +Era in Threat.
Neutral: No mods. 
Defence: +5 Block if you can block, else +5 Melee Defence. -5 To-hit and -2 Max damage, -Era in Threat.
[*]Added a bit of variety to some monster pics and stats, this is an ongoing process.
[*]Added some basic combat animation, this is also an ongoing process.
[*]Added Trade Worldskill to scouting results.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Overhaul of the Combat screen. Many display changes.
[*]Overhaul of To-Hit calculations. (To show the monsters chance to hit their current target, you will need a high level in Monster Lore).
[*]Changed the price for heartwood. It has little use for such expense.
[*]Removed the marble tools recipe as marble is no longer available.
[*]Lowered the Barrel recipe to only need 5 food to research. Also changed the materials needed to make the Barrel to require 2 copper ingots instead of a bronze sheet.
[*]Slight increase in damage from all monsters and an increase in a few monsters armour penetration values.
[*]Block Damage Values have increased for all items to cancel out the increase in damage.
[*]Increased the amount of XP gained from worldskill scouting results to be more based on the current Era.
[*]Dropped the guaranteed settlement scouting result from 10 missed chances to 8.
[*]Researching the various metals now gives metal lore instead of giving the smelting skill to your researcher.
[*]Changed the Well to use stone instead of shaped rock as shaped rock is an Era4 item and the Well is Era 3.
[*]Changed treasure tables to allow Scouting books but deny Assassin, Scientist and Blademaster books.
[*]Reduced the price for basic herbs, they only have 1 rare recipe and should not hold much value.
[*]Leather backpacks and Beds have been changed to give craftsman skill on research, instead of research skill.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b] 
[list]
[*]Overhaul of the combat system. Many minor bugs fixed.
[*]Corrected some text errors.
[*]Fixed an error in the Pet Wolf's attack. It should now hit more often when assisting in combat.
[*]Fixed an issue with questers and scouts returning early during a game reload.
[*]Fixed some advanced skill display issues.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Headhunter brothers would turn up in regular encounters.
[*]Fixed a combination of actions that could cause a character to disappear when they updated themselves in the customize window.
[*]Fixed an issue where if you fled from the Big Rubble Quest, you would no longer be able to return to try again.
[*]Fixed an issue that would block the purchase of Feats that required other feats.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Sandmen quest.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Goliath quest.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Warmachines not showing on the walls.
[/list]

tags.feature:
[*]Stances!
You can now set a combat stance for each frontline character. Changing stance does not take up your action. The stances are:
Attack: +5 To-hit and +2 Max damage, -5 Block and -5 Melee Defence. +Era in Threat.
Neutral: No mods. 
Defence: +5 Block if you can block, else +5 Melee Defence. -5 To-hit and -2 Max damage, -Era in Threat.
[*]Added a bit of variety to some monster pics and stats, this is an ongoing process.
[*]Added some basic combat animation, this is also an ongoing process.
[*]Added Trade Worldskill to scouting results.

tags.balance_change: [*]Changed the price for heartwood. It has little use for such expense.

[*]Increased the amount of XP gained from worldskill scouting results to be more based on the current Era.
[*]Dropped the guaranteed settlement scouting result from 10 missed chances to 8.
[*]Researching the various metals now gives metal lore instead of giving the smelting skill to your researcher.
[*]Changed the Well to use stone instead of shaped rock as shaped rock is an Era4 item and the Well is Era 3.
[*]Changed treasure tables to allow Scouting books but deny Assassin, Scientist and Blademaster books.
[*]Reduced the price for basic herbs, they only have 1 rare recipe and should not hold much value.

notes.title: Closed Beta T8.9 - Slayer Book & Ancient Data Deeds
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATES[/h1]
[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the Slayer Deed Book. To access the book, click on scrapbooks.
Inside there will be a list of the current monster types and a bar showing progress to unlocking an Ancient Data Deed.
These Deeds can be unlocked once, however you can claim them again if you start a new game. For now there is only 1 tier available for these slayer deeds, there may be more in the future depending on content updates for monsters.
[*]The Ancient Data Deeds will stay with you through multiple playthroughs until they are spent on unlocking Hard-mode or Advanced items. The system and items for you to spend these Deeds on are not yet implemented, but you can still save up the deeds ready.
[*]Added a tooltip to the Central plot upgrade buildings to show what Era they are.
[*]Added Copper dagger to the weapons lists as all of the early daggers were treasure only.
[*]Added Slayer Deed Achievements.
[/list]



[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the amount of building damage taken from an abandoned settlement defence.
[*]Change the tooltip on Hit Points in character view to better show when the character is injured.
[*]Increased the odds of a skilled Scout evading enemy when on a scout mission.
[*]Changed the Skillbook button in the character sheet to be hidden when you are already reading a book
[*]Changed some recipe and material values.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b] 
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the unlock process showing the incorrect icon for Energy & Composites.
[*]Fixed an issue with the pop-up now closing too fast when a settlement is attacked.
[*]Fixed an issue that would show tooltip information on some buildings you have not discovered.
[*]Fixed an issue where looking at the feats would give you skill 0 in some skills.
[*]Fixed an issue where the resource follow bar would temporarily lock up after viewing the character customisation panel.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Central plot option to upgrade to the 1st storage level would become unavailable.
[*]Fixed issue with the item display not resetting to ALL when it is re-opened
[*]Fixed the Research Study recipe, material error.
[*]Fixed an issue with the spiked defences artwork showing when in battles outside of a settlement. 
[*]Fixed an issue with purchasing feats checked against skills.
[*]Fixed an issue with some central plot artwork not clearing.
[*]Fixed an issue with Scouts not showing in the settlement the moment they return.
[*]Fixed an issue with special recipes found in treasure, not unlocking.
[*]Fixed a display bug in some quests.
[*]Fixed an issue in some cases where people did not read their skillbooks.
[*]Fixed an issue where a new settlement would not show without a refresh of the world screen
[*]Cleaned up some artwork.
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Beta T8.8.5 - Game Patch
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATES[/h1]
[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to spend 1 Diplomacy point to gain 10 old age coins.
[*]Added more artwork - there should be no placeholder artwork during Early Access builds. (With the exception of Merchants! - WiP)
[*]Several new feats have been added to link up with recent content updates.
[/list]

[b]Change[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the max craft and research level available through all buildings to be Era 7. As I unlock each future era, I will up the crafting levels of the buildings. This is the safest way to control unlocks with minimal chance of bugs and broken save games.
[*]Changed the Doomclock advancement, the current era has a slight positive and negative effect on the Doomclock points gained from combat failure and unlocking new settlements.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue due to the recent changes in the GUI interface, quests would not reset the people going. 
[*]Fixed an issue with the ALL sounds setting, not changing the volume.
[*]Fixed an issue with food consumption in the Science Lab.
[*]Fixed some unlock text issues, showing debug information.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Doomclock would not move if you were on the world view screen.
[*]Fixed an issue where you could click on some Menu items when the menu was intended to be locked.
[*]Fixed an error in the Achievements for Doomclock 50+ and 75+, they are now obtainable.
[*]Fixed an issue where a war-machine image could be in a non-settlement combat. (Even though it was doing no damage).
[*]Fixed an issue where 2 treasure chests could be awarded if a multi-strike attack killed the last monster on the first attack.
[*]Fixed an issue with special items dropping in normal treasure.

notes.title: Closed Beta 0.8.8 - CHARACTER RELOCATION!
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATES[/h1]
[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Character Relocation
This must be the number 1 feature request. Nearly all of you have asked me to implement a way of moving characters from settlement to settlement. So here you have it!!
[img=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/d8a3e52dd216e277ef1bfb8f0e78129505588d97.jpg]

At the bottom of your character sheet is a new button. Pressing this will send your character to a free world Exchange Slot. (You only have 2 of these so if they are full this button will not show!).
It will also create an Exchange Slot in the Settlement. As can be seen here:
[img=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30745047/bc45b57bd6c14bf88d0747157371be208f6427b8.jpg]

When you switch to the world map you will see any characters available for exchange, in the top right of your screen.
Clicking on a character will allow you to select any Settlement with an open exchange slot for them to move into. (You can also Right Click them to review their details, however you cannot change anything they have!).
 
There are strict rules governing how house slots are now applied. 
These are:
[u]House Deletion / Destruction[/u]
1) Any Exchange slot allocated to that house will now become blocked. A blocked slot will become free again once more housing is built. 
2) Any homeless from this deletion will move into any other building that had an exchange slot available. Blocking those slots.
[u]House Creation[/u]
1) If there is a homeless Character in the settlement, they will move into the house first.
2) If there are blocked exchange slots, they will free up for each new character slot.
3) If there are no blocked exchange slots nor homeless people, you gain new characters as normal.
[u]Sending Characters Away.[/u]
1) If there are homeless, they will take the characters house slot and create a blocked exchange slot.
[u]Character Death[/u]
1) If a character dies and you have homeless or blocked exchange slots, a new family will not move in.
[u]Characters in World Exchange Slots[/u]
1) Cannot be sent on Quests
	2) Cannot defend Settlements
	3) Do not become homeless
	4) Do not heal or suffer damage

[*]Added more artwork.
[*]Added more voice.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Locked down the viewing of character sheets when outside of a village to reduce possible errors. You can now only use the customise feature, change equipment, scout and other actions while viewing a character within a settlement.
[*]Losing a settlement battle now costs you 10 points on the doomsday clock.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a loading 85 error
[*]Tooltips in Character view were incorrect or missing on some buttons.
[*]The Treasure Icon should appear quicker on the screen, rather than the current delay.
[*]The merchant Icon should appear/clear quicker on the screen, rather than the current delay.
[*]Fixed an issue with moving characters around the screen that would get them stuck on the mouse pointer.
[*]Fixed an issue with the damage colour for characters not showing in a timely fashion from a game reload.
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Beta T8.7 - Character Equipment Slot Update
notes.content:
Default path is now T8.6.3
Beta path is now T8.7


UPDATES
Additions
·	Character Equipment Slot upgrade! 
I have promised to separate the Helmet and Misc item slot for some time. 
Well now you not only have your wish but you also have an EXTRA misc slot as well - yes that is a Helmet slot and 2 Misc slots. - Yay!
There is a restriction on the slot usage - you cannot equip the same item into both misc slots. (You cannot equip 2 archery bracers for both bonuses!!).
This will allow me to add a lot more minor misc items and 1 use items for combat. (Grenades!)
Your current saves should update the location of character helms. If not, please re-equip your helm.
 
·	Added more building artwork.
·	Added more tooltips
·	Ranged advanced attacks are now available to be used in Frontline combat.(Penalty to hit enemy front line troops is still active!).
·	Multiple Misc items in Combat
When in combat the character main Misc slot will now just say MISC ITEMS. When you click on this it will bring up any misc items you are carrying at the bottom of the combat screen, where your advanced weapon attacks are shown.
Tooltips will explain if the item has a Click-To-Use function or not. Clicking on such an item will use it.
 
·	New World Skill: Monster Lore
You can now start training in Monster Lore from Era 1 onwards. The information you obtain in combat is based upon this skill as follows:
Skill 0 - Monster Name
Skill 1 - Type
Skill 2 - Melee and Ranged Defence
Skill 3 - Subtype
Skill 4 - Current and Max Hit Points
Skill 5 - Melee Damage and Ranged Damage
Skill 6 - Armour Value
Skill 7 - Blocking Skills and Blocking Value
Skill 8 - Melee and Ranged Attack Skill
Skill 9 - Special Ability, Critical Type and Critical Hit %
Skill 10 - Bio-weapon effect.
Monster Lore has been added to the scouting treasure tables.

Changes
·	Character view has been changed to better show on different screen resolutions.
·	Razor has now been changed to a returning encounter boss. He will initially appear as usual once you have taken settlement 3. He has the full 3 random special loot items like other bosses, however his gauntlets are a rare drop due to their powerful stats.
·	Ranged reserves in combat can now only use rapid shot if they have the skill requirement to use Twin attack or better with the weapon they have equipped.

Bugs 
·	Fixed a combat issue where melee advanced options were available when the character switched to ranged weapons in the Frontline.
·	Fixed an issue with camp fires showing in settlement defence when they are not built.
·	Fixed an issue where both Helm and Shield dexterity penalties in combat were not being adjusted.
·	Fixed an error with the display of Ranged Block with shields.
·	Fixed an error with the threat from misc items not showing on the Character sheet.
·	Fixed an error where Hit Point bonuses from items were not being awarded.

notes.title: Closed Beta T8.6.2 - General Patch
notes.content:
Closed Beta T8.6.2 -  General Patch

Default path is now T8.6.2
Beta path is now T8. 6.2

General Notes:
Although I am working through the Science trees, I still suggest only progressing to Era 7 to use factories. All other Era 7-10 content is not complete and I am still not unlocking Bio-Chemistry and Settlement 7 (The Oil Well) until Era7-10 is more complete.

UPDATES
Additions
·	Damage values have been added to the combat blood splashes.
·	More Skill information text has been added to the Right-Click tips.

Changes
·	Homeless test: I have decided to test a different Health loss calculation for homeless instead of the "happy bar!", to see if it works. Homeless people will now suffer 2 * the current Era in damage per tick. This will mean that the initial playing around with housing that happens in Era 1 will have minimal effect (2 hp per tick was the default damage until now). However loss of housing or attempting to keep homeless workers will get very difficult to sustain as the game progresses.
·	Changed some short name descriptions of skills so they better fit into the 'Locked' chest quests.
·	Characters now have their full title and name shown via tooltip when in the combat screen.
·	Reduced overall attack difficulty when settlements are under attack. (There is now a greater chance of lower era monsters showing up!)
·	Unarmed attack had all attack options available for it - This was a bug. However due to popular demand I have lowered the level at which the extra attacks show up for unarmed. Twin attack has dropped from 6 to 2 and Wild attack has dropped from 8 to 6. This means that unarmed attack gets extra attacks before any other weapon type except for fully automatic guns.

Bugs 
·	Gunslinger and Scientist skills both had the incorrect difficulty levels. They have both been corrected to "Specialist". 
·	Fixed some resizing issues with the customisation screen.
·	Fixed an issue where advanced combat skill 4 was showing incorrectly.
·	Advanced Combat ability: Spray - had the incorrect picture and did not perform the correct attack pattern. Spray should also only be available on automatic weapons (it was showing up on unarmed!)
·	It was still possible to click on the Xmas event 'hidden' tree even though the event was over. Sorry but Santa has gone. No more gifts for you!

notes.title: Closed Beta T5 Update 6
notes.content:
Welcome to Closed Beta T5 Update 6


UPDATES
Additions
·	More plotline & Artwork.
·	All Flee!
You now have the ability for everyone to abandon the battle at once. If you do this during a settlement attack you will be given notice as to the damage the settlement will take. - Having walls = you can hide behind them.
·	Settlement damage
In the event of a flee in defence or a failed defence, your settlement buildings will now take damage. They will slowly repair overtime unless destroyed in the fight.
·	Building repair. As above.
·	2 new Settlement central functions. Health and Utilities. These are added now to help support late game functions. However there are some early buildings here that can really help.
·	Quester!
Ready to support more settlers, the quest page has changed. First it has been split into 2 sections, Frontline and Reserves - you can still allocate people where you wish, it just helps view larger numbers of characters at once.
You can also set every character to be either Quester or Defender. If they are set to defender, they will not appear on the quest selector.

Changes
·	A new merchant script was delivered in a hotfix
·	Added Sling (hide) so that you could make slings in Era 3. 
·	Reduced the wheat cost of bread from 5 wheat to 4 wheat and reduced baking time.
·	Heartwood should be a rare, not a standard resource.
·	Moved some buildings into the correct central slots.
·	Changed a few armour Era 3-4 stats and materials.
·	Removed Scrolls from the basic library as that leads to a catch-22.

Bugs
·	Fixed a display issue with some merchant item quantities.
·	Fixed a healme error.
·	Items were saying they were giving Health bonus when in fact they should have been saying Hit Point bonus.
·	Fixed an issue with Combat Medic not working correctly.
·	Fixed character portrait background colours resetting on reload.
·	Fixed a shield allocation bug
·	Fixed the Basic Library not being able to research Scholar
·	Fixed an issue with sword critical doing crazy damage!

Welcome to Closed Beta T5 Update 6


UPDATES
Additions
·	More plotline & Artwork.
·	All Flee!
You now have the ability for everyone to abandon the battle at once. If you do this during a settlement attack you will be given notice as to the damage the settlement will take. - Having walls = you can hide behind them.
·	Settlement damage
In the event of a flee in defence or a failed defence, your settlement buildings will now take damage. They will slowly repair overtime unless destroyed in the fight.
·	Building repair. As above.
·	2 new Settlement central functions. Health and Utilities. These are added now to help support late game functions. However there are some early buildings here that can really help.
·	Quester!
Ready to support more settlers, the quest page has changed. First it has been split into 2 sections, Frontline and Reserves - you can still allocate people where you wish, it just helps view larger numbers of characters at once.
You can also set every character to be either Quester or Defender. If they are set to defender, they will not appear on the quest selector.
