notes.title: Closed Beta T4 v5
notes.content:
Welcome to Closed Beta T4 v5

Please be aware that any and all of what you are testing may change between now and final release.

Save File Incompatibility
Unfortunately your current save games will no loner work. I do intend to keep such events to a minimum but sadly this is all part of Closed Beta testing. Some features I add will break your save file.

Achievement Wipe
The game will now produce an achievement wipe. You will not be able to obtain achievements this build. They will work again on the next update.

Settings
Please note that until we are closer to release, each update I push out will wipe your settings file and place it back at default. Any sound and screen preferences you have will have to be reset.

GOAL
Combat has undergone many changes. I suggest you play-test combat with an eye on bugs and imbalance.

STRETCH GOAL
As previous, Settlement 4 works. I am now working its way through Era 6 data and Era 3 + 4 item & building artwork. So I suggest you do not push past Era 3 if you want the game to still look nice :)

UPDATES
Features
·	Greater Character Customisation Part 1: Name Change. You can now change the forename and family name of your characters. On the character view panel there is a quill to the left of your characters name - clicking this will bring up the option screen. You must provide both a Forename and Family name. 
As development continues there will be many added features to allow you to further customise your characters. 
·	Critical Strikes: Critical hits have been added, each weapon has a standard chance of 5% with a maximum +2% for skill = 7%. Rare weapons have 10% with a maximum of 3% for skill giving 13%.  Monsters criticals are 5% unless bosses. The Critical hits are not meant to be heavily unbalanced, more of a reward to the more skilled characters. Support defenders cannot score a critical. Currently there are 3 types.
Some monsters may be immune to these criticals.
o	Stun/Stagger (Clubs and Blunts) - For each round you are affected you will lose initiative and Melee Defence, based upon the weapons (default is 10)
o	Bleed (Spears and Arrows) - For each round you are affected you will bleed a set amount based on the weapon. (default is 5hp for 2 rounds).
o	Slash (Swords) - You perform an extra 20% damage.
·	Combat Medic: In order to gain this skill you first need to equip a Healing item in your Misc slot. There are currently 3 in game. Healing Herbs, Bandages or Medical Dressings. These items can be used ONCE in a combat for a large heal to all Melee characters. This will give Combat Medic XP and unlock the combat medic skill for that character.
Once unlocked you can use this skill every turn for a minor heal to all Melee characters including the medic of 3hp/Skill Rank. - starts of low but 30hp/turn to everyone at Rank 10 is very powerful. Caution - watch your threat.
On top of this, anyone with Combat Medic in the reserve area will increase the amount that reserves heal each turn.

Changes
·	Combat Rebalance: Several changes to the way Combat Agro is shown and calculated.
o	Starting Agro is shared out evenly between all melee characters.
o	The amount of change per turn is less random and more based upon who is drawing agro - hitting a monster is liable to keep that monster attacking you for longer. (Attempting to hit a monster will still annoy it even if you miss! - as always ranged attacks generate less agro)
o	Easier to View: If you mouse over a character, all monsters attacking that character are shown by large Red flags. This makes assessing agro each turn much quicker.
o	Dodge - better known as run around like an idiot for a turn, has a greater effect vs the monsters chasing you than those attacking someone else. They are more likely to go after a new target however in the past the others would also equally ignore you - this is no longer the case. If you wish to clear your agro with all monsters, you will need to swap with a reserve - no reserves, then it may take several turns of dodge. Inspire and combat heal will still annoy all monsters equally.
o	Characters with High Threat (Due to equipment) will generate more agro per turn than characters with less threat. Make sure your high threat characters are meant to be your melee 'Tank'.
o	Formation generates small amounts of threat to the formation and not to the leader.
o	If a settlement is attacked while characters are still recovering from a previous combat (they may have just gone out on assault) then they will automatically have a minimum of 50% health to protect their homes.
·	Changed crafter's guild to require Research 3 instead of craftsman skill to research as the Research building chain should be the default for nearly all building research.


Bugs
·	Ability to transfer characters between settlement. This has been stopped as it is not part of the game design. If a similar feature has enough demand, I will look to implement it via a different method.
·	Fixed a bug whereby when you cleared a building site that you no longer wish to build, the screen would not update your clearance in a timely fashion.
·	Achievement 5 Star and 10 Star were being incorrectly calculated.

Welcome to Closed Beta T4 v5

Please be aware that any and all of what you are testing may change between now and final release.

Save File Incompatibility
Unfortunately your current save games will no loner work. I do intend to keep such events to a minimum but sadly this is all part of Closed Beta testing. Some features I add will break your save file.

Achievement Wipe
The game will now produce an achievement wipe. You will not be able to obtain achievements this build. They will work again on the next update.

Settings
Please note that until we are closer to release, each update I push out will wipe your settings file and place it back at default. Any sound and screen preferences you have will have to be reset.

GOAL
Combat has undergone many changes. I suggest you play-test combat with an eye on bugs and imbalance.

STRETCH GOAL
As previous, Settlement 4 works. I am now working its way through Era 6 data and Era 3 + 4 item & building artwork. So I suggest you do not push past Era 3 if you want the game to still look nice :)

UPDATES
Features
·	Greater Character Customisation Part 1: Name Change. You can now change the forename and family name of your characters. On the character view panel there is a quill to the left of your characters name - clicking this will bring up the option screen. You must provide both a Forename and Family name. 
As development continues there will be many added features to allow you to further customise your characters. 
·	Critical Strikes: Critical hits have been added, each weapon has a standard chance of 5% with a maximum +2% for skill = 7%. Rare weapons have 10% with a maximum of 3% for skill giving 13%.  Monsters criticals are 5% unless bosses. The Critical hits are not meant to be heavily unbalanced, more of a reward to the more skilled characters. Support defenders cannot score a critical. Currently there are 3 types.
Some monsters may be immune to these criticals.
o	Stun/Stagger (Clubs and Blunts) - For each round you are affected you will lose initiative and Melee Defence, based upon the weapons (default is 10)
o	Bleed (Spears and Arrows) - For each round you are affected you will bleed a set amount based on the weapon. (default is 5hp for 2 rounds).
o	Slash (Swords) - You perform an extra 20% damage.
·	Combat Medic: In order to gain this skill you first need to equip a Healing item in your Misc slot. There are currently 3 in game. Healing Herbs, Bandages or Medical Dressings. These items can be used ONCE in a combat for a large heal to all Melee characters. This will give Combat Medic XP and unlock the combat medic skill for that character.
Once unlocked you can use this skill every turn for a minor heal to all Melee characters including the medic of 3hp/Skill Rank. - starts of low but 30hp/turn to everyone at Rank 10 is very powerful. Caution - watch your threat.
On top of this, anyone with Combat Medic in the reserve area will increase the amount that reserves heal each turn.

Changes
·	Combat Rebalance: Several changes to the way Combat Agro is shown and calculated.
o	Starting Agro is shared out evenly between all melee characters.
o	The amount of change per turn is less random and more based upon who is drawing agro - hitting a monster is liable to keep that monster attacking you for longer. (Attempting to hit a monster will still annoy it even if you miss! - as always ranged attacks generate less agro)
o	Easier to View: If you mouse over a character, all monsters attacking that character are shown by large Red flags. This makes assessing agro each turn much quicker.
o	Dodge - better known as run around like an idiot for a turn, has a greater effect vs the monsters chasing you than those attacking someone else. They are more likely to go after a new target however in the past the others would also equally ignore you - this is no longer the case. If you wish to clear your agro with all monsters, you will need to swap with a reserve - no reserves, then it may take several turns of dodge. Inspire and combat heal will still annoy all monsters equally.
o	Characters with High Threat (Due to equipment) will generate more agro per turn than characters with less threat. Make sure your high threat characters are meant to be your melee 'Tank'.
o	Formation generates small amounts of threat to the formation and not to the leader.
o	If a settlement is attacked while characters are still recovering from a previous combat (they may have just gone out on assault) then they will automatically have a minimum of 50% health to protect their homes.
·	Changed crafter's guild to require Research 3 instead of craftsman skill to research as the Research building chain should be the default for nearly all building research.

·	Fixed an issue whereby Merchants available in a current game would follow you into a new game or previous save - nice of them but they have been banned from being so helpful!
·	Fixed an issue whereby a current game with a high threat rating being abandoned for a new game or previous save could cause an attack to take place before the new settlements had loaded. Yet again, monsters cheating and they have also been banned from doing so!
·	Fixed an issue where Block buffs were not shown in green on the battle screen when Formation was used.

·	Fixed an issue where wall defences would show on a village defence even if you have not built any.

Welcome to Closed Beta T4 v4

Please be aware that any and all of what you are testing may change between now and final release.

Critical Error
In version 1 there was an error whereby if you build the 3 family house, the game would jump to Late Bronze, even though it is Early bronze. If you have this then you must either start a new game with the latest build out today or if you contact me I can guide you through editing your save game. Please be aware there will be an achievement and save game wipe probably in the next build as it will have more advanced combat.

GOAL
Hi all, the Goal for this release is to venture towards Settlement 3, finding bugs and reporting them! Please also start to think about difficulty and pace - feedback is very helpful. As both Settlement 3 and 4 have had their encounters tweaked with added abilities, I would save before you try. 
If you are having difficulty with mass combat, watch the colours in-front of each monster. That is the Agro you are generating and who they will attack next. Try hitting monsters that are going for your weakest characters, that way you can draw them off. Always try and be Agro free before you use Inspire or Combat Heal! Using Dodge will drop your agro.

STRETCH GOAL
Fill out your 3rd Settlement with new buildings and work on your Late Bronze equipment. 
You can head towards Settlement 4 if you wish but you are pushing towards the end of the current content. You will also not have Combat Medics nor the ability to Stagger or Bleed your foes. (Mind you the same applies towards you!)
My own personal game has not progressed that far so expect bugs, many! Also the lack of the main plotline will also start to impact on the game. However you are welcome to try.

UPDATES
Features
·	The Doom Clock: Changed world threat gain to be slower. If the Doom clock becomes full (Threat 100) then the game will End. World threat no longer affects Village threat. Later on Special Boss Encounters will be placed on the map each time a new clock panel is highlighted (for the first time).
·	Ability to Delete a Character: Careful of that diplomacy loss, you are going to need it!
·	Monster Ranged Combat: Reserve line monsters with ranged combat ability will now look to fire at your reserves and melee characters. Walls offer appropriate protection for your reserves and Melee gain the +25 Ranged def for being in melee as do Monsters.
·	Monster Abilities: The start of Monster abilities are now in. 
o	Sha-Kha has a Healing Howl that she will use 20% of the time. This will heal 5HP to all her wolfpack.
o	The Spawn will spawn Vine Imps each time it is hit up to a maximum of 27 Vine Imps in battle at one time. Thank me that they do not have ranged!
·	Settlement 4: Settlement 4, known as the Spawn Pool is now in. Be aware that you will be heading into Late, late Bronze age and chasing Iron Age, as such many things may not have pictures. However all basic content should work.

Changes
·	Changed the Threat Info Screen to inform of DoomsDay clock changes
·	Changed the Settlement Attack Info Screens to highlight the type of attack
·	Changed Alpha Wolf to Sha-Kha
·	Reduced feedback when a character has no more rooms for skills.
·	Added feedback message showing when there are no more quest space.
·	Buying or Selling to a Merchant will grant World Skill: Trade xp per 100c
·	Changed the initial battle Agro so that Character 1 does not get more than their fair share.
·	The player now receives healing notification when a character in the reserve area obtains its end of turn recovery heal.
·	Added Threat loss if you lose a Village defence as well as if you win. 12 hour timer applies to both.
·	Crazed Settler now has a Ranged attack.
·	Wall Ranged defences have changed: Palisade is now +40, Palisade and Towers are now +50, Castle walls are now +60
·	Walls now offer a Ranged advantage to your reserves and town Ranged Militia. Palisade is: +10 To-Hit, Palisade and Towers are:  +13 To-Hit and Castle Walls are: +15 To-Hit



Bugs
Fixed a bug in the armour tables that would cause a crash
Fixed a bug that allowed 5 people to go on a 4 person Mission.
Fixed a bug that counted the first person on a mission as 2.
Fixed an issue where the main music would restart after a reload or new game.

notes.title: Latest Build T4 v4
notes.content:
Welcome to Closed Beta T4 v4

Please be aware that any and all of what you are testing may change between now and final release.

Critical Error
In version 1 there was an error whereby if you build the 3 family house, the game would jump to Late Bronze, even though it is Early bronze. If you have this then you must either start a new game with the latest build out today or if you contact me I can guide you through editing your save game. Please be aware there will be an achievement and save game wipe probably in the next build as it will have more advanced combat.

GOAL
Hi all, the Goal for this release is to venture towards Settlement 3, finding bugs and reporting them! Please also start to think about difficulty and pace - feedback is very helpful. As both Settlement 3 and 4 have had their encounters tweaked with added abilities, I would save before you try. 
If you are having difficulty with mass combat, watch the colours in-front of each monster. That is the Agro you are generating and who they will attack next. Try hitting monsters that are going for your weakest characters, that way you can draw them off. Always try and be Agro free before you use Inspire or Combat Heal! Using Dodge will drop your agro.

STRETCH GOAL
Fill out your 3rd Settlement with new buildings and work on your Late Bronze equipment. 
You can head towards Settlement 4 if you wish but you are pushing towards the end of the current content. You will also not have Combat Medics nor the ability to Stagger or Bleed your foes. (Mind you the same applies towards you!)
My own personal game has not progressed that far so expect bugs, many! Also the lack of the main plotline will also start to impact on the game. However you are welcome to try.

UPDATES
Features
·	The Doom Clock: Changed world threat gain to be slower. If the Doom clock becomes full (Threat 100) then the game will End. World threat no longer affects Village threat. Later on Special Boss Encounters will be placed on the map each time a new clock panel is highlighted (for the first time).
·	Ability to Delete a Character: Careful of that diplomacy loss, you are going to need it!
·	Monster Ranged Combat: Reserve line monsters with ranged combat ability will now look to fire at your reserves and melee characters. Walls offer appropriate protection for your reserves and Melee gain the +25 Ranged def for being in melee as do Monsters.
·	Monster Abilities: The start of Monster abilities are now in. 
o	Sha-Kha has a Healing Howl that she will use 20% of the time. This will heal 5HP to all her wolfpack.
o	The Spawn will spawn Vine Imps each time it is hit up to a maximum of 27 Vine Imps in battle at one time. Thank me that they do not have ranged!
·	Settlement 4: Settlement 4, known as the Spawn Pool is now in. Be aware that you will be heading into Late, late Bronze age and chasing Iron Age, as such many things may not have pictures. However all basic content should work.

Changes
·	Changed the Threat Info Screen to inform of DoomsDay clock changes

·	Changed Alpha Wolf to Sha-Kha
·	Reduced feedback when a character has no more rooms for skills.

·	Changed the initial battle Agro so that Character 1 does not get more than their fair share.
·	The player now receives healing notification when a character in the reserve area obtains its end of turn recovery heal.
·	Added Threat loss if you lose a Village defence as well as if you win. 12 hour timer applies to both.
·	Crazed Settler now has a Ranged attack.
·	Wall Ranged defences have changed: Palisade is now +40, Palisade and Towers are now +50, Castle walls are now +60
·	Walls now offer a Ranged advantage to your reserves and town Ranged Militia. Palisade is: +10 To-Hit, Palisade and Towers are:  +13 To-Hit and Castle Walls are: +15 To-Hit



Bugs
